events.description: Colossal bronze Ring grinding clockwise above Veyra
Roadside holographic terminal snapping three hero dossiers into focus
Velocity's golden lightning aura crackling atop the Eastern Watchtower
Velocity and Traveler streaking toward the plaza maintenance hatch
Subterranean intercom blaring with Aegis Prime's urgent distress call
Velocity blurring across the workbench in golden lightning to re-wire robot M-04
Ceiling gantries slamming down and welding cobalt hydraulic armor onto the Traveler
Crimson shockwaves hammering the laboratory firewall as the underground signal counter-attacks
Emerald data helix spiraling into the air-gapped wristband as ARCHITECT-S1 wakes
Velocity, M-04, and the Traveler's hydraulic gauntlets heaving the collapsed steel girder off Aegis
Hundreds of levitating armor plates slamming together into the towering colossus
Velocity rushing Aegis Prime out of the vault toward medical care
Colossus firing the blazing kinetic sphere and Traveler catching and hurling it back
Traveler vaulting onto the giant's sweeping fist and sprinting up its rippling arm
Electromagnetic boot clamps locking onto the giant's shifting shoulder plate
ARCHITECT-S2 unfolding from the modular metal cube and morphing from star to shield to guardian
Mosaic's armor warming into radiant rose-gold as it claims its name
Thunderous metallic boom as the colossal Ring above Veyra slams to a dead halt
